binding.root: fresh reviewer verification of the exact Git commit and tree containing this manifest
required_reviewer_checks: resolve and record exact HEAD commit
resolve and record exact parent commit
resolve and record exact HEAD tree
verify a clean detached checkout before and after inspection
recompute the finite path inventory, count, and path-name SHA-256
verify every inventoried path from the exact Git tree
verify zero generated curve-family density rows and zero runs
verify maximum_runs=0 and no launch-plan or execution authority

inventory_rules.canonical_encoding: sorted repository-relative POSIX paths joined with newline and one terminal newline

limitations: The path-name digest does not bind file bytes; the independently verified exact Git tree binds bytes.
The manifest intentionally omits V17 review and closeout outputs that do not exist in the pre-review commit.
The manifest does not authorize launch-plan design or execution.
A later protocol version must refresh the inventory if its review surface changes.
